_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Muntu a Surround mu {width}x{height} kikua.
Ngeye muntu {player_id}. Mikweso ya kwamba: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kana w/s/a/d.
Kulungu: kuikala kuwa na bantu bosi. Mikweso ya muntu ina kuwa na nda; kukwata kwa kikua kuna kuwa na nda; kukwata kwa muntu wawili kuna kuwa na nda bosi.

board.after_moves: O kididi kiki, ki tena ku kala sé mukengeji: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Muntu {player_id} akufi kwa mikweso isivyo ya kwamba.

outcome.all_crashed: O athu oso akexile mu álaka a di bhukana.
outcome.turn_limit: Mikolo ya kuzunguka ikwendi - ukulungu uvambele.
